concepts.title: Simple Hindi Passages
concepts.description: Simple Hindi Passages — part of the chapter on पढ़ना (Reading).
key_ideas: Core principles of simple hindi passages
Step-by-step problem solving for simple hindi passages
Real-world applications of simple hindi passages

concepts.title: Comprehension Questions
concepts.description: Comprehension Questions — part of the chapter on पढ़ना (Reading).
key_ideas: Step-by-step problem solving for comprehension questions

concepts.title: Reading Aloud (Swar Pathan)
concepts.description: Practicing the oral reading of sentences and short paragraphs with correct pronunciation and natural flow.

concepts.title: Poetry and Rhythm (Kavita Pathan)
concepts.description: Reading short poems with attention to rhyming sounds and rhythmic patterns distinct from prose.
key_ideas: Following the rhythm of the poem

concepts.title: Contextual Vocabulary (Sandarbh mein Shabd)
concepts.description: Understanding the meaning of new or difficult words based on the context of the sentence or story.
key_ideas: Using context clues to guess meaning
Connecting words to pictures or situations

concepts.title: Character Identification (Patra Parichay)
concepts.description: Identifying the main characters in a story and attributing specific actions or dialogue to them.

concepts.title: Sequencing Events (Ghatna Kram)
concepts.description: Arranging the events of a story in the correct chronological order to demonstrate understanding of the narrative flow.
key_ideas: Identifying the beginning, middle, and end
Ordering jumbled sentences from a story

concepts.title: Word Writing Practice
concepts.description: Word Writing Practice — part of the chapter on लेखन (Writing).
key_ideas: Core principles of word writing practice
Step-by-step problem solving for word writing practice
Real-world applications of word writing practice

concepts.title: Sentence Formation
concepts.description: Sentence Formation — part of the chapter on लेखन (Writing).
key_ideas: Step-by-step problem solving for sentence formation

concepts.title: Handwriting Improvement (Sulekh)
concepts.description: Focusing on the art of beautiful and legible handwriting, emphasizing correct stroke order, spacing, and the alignment of the 'Shirorekha' (top line).
key_ideas: Correct formation of Hindi letters and matras
Importance of the Shirorekha (top horizontal line)

concepts.title: Picture Composition (Chitra Varnan)
concepts.description: Developing the ability to observe a picture and describe the scene, objects, or actions taking place using simple, grammatically correct sentences.
key_ideas: Constructing 3-5 sentences based on visual cues

concepts.title: Story Completion (Kahani Purti)
concepts.description: Completing a short story by filling in blanks with appropriate words from a help box or finishing the last few sentences of a narrative.
key_ideas: Understanding the flow of a simple narrative

concepts.title: Short Paragraph Writing (Anuched Lekhan)
concepts.description: Writing a cohesive short paragraph (5-8 lines) on familiar topics such as 'My School', 'My Best Friend', or 'My Favorite Festival'.
key_ideas: Structuring thoughts around a single topic
Connecting sentences to form a meaningful paragraph

concepts.title: संज्ञा — Nouns
concepts.description: संज्ञा — Nouns — part of the chapter on बुनियादी व्याकरण.

concepts.title: सर्वनाम — Pronouns
concepts.description: सर्वनाम — Pronouns — part of the chapter on बुनियादी व्याकरण.

concepts.title: वचन — Singular and Plural
concepts.description: वचन — Singular and Plural — part of the chapter on बुनियादी व्याकरण.

concepts.title: लिंग — Gender (Masculine and Feminine)
concepts.description: Introduction to the gender of nouns, distinguishing between masculine (Pulling) and feminine (Striling) words.
key_ideas: Changing the gender of common nouns

concepts.title: विशेषण — Adjectives
concepts.description: Understanding words that describe the quality, color, shape, or number of a noun.
key_ideas: Words describing quality (e.g., Good, Bad, Beautiful)
Words describing colors and sizes (e.g., Red, Big, Small)

concepts.title: क्रिया — Verbs (Action Words)
concepts.description: Introduction to action words that tell us what someone or something is doing.
key_ideas: Identifying action words (e.g., Khana, Pina, Sona)
Matching actions to the correct doer
Understanding that every sentence usually has a verb

concepts.title: विलोम शब्द — Antonyms
concepts.description: Learning pairs of words that have completely opposite meanings.
key_ideas: Concept of opposites (Ulte Arth Wale Shabd)
Using antonyms to change the meaning of a phrase

concepts.title: वाक्य रचना — Simple Sentence Formation
concepts.description: Combining nouns, pronouns, and verbs to form meaningful, grammatically correct simple sentences.
key_ideas: Correct word order: Subject + Object + Verb
Ensuring the verb agrees with the number (Singular/Plural)
Constructing simple sentences like 'Ram plays' or 'She eats'
